modern-current-2026-oh.title: Pushbuild2026 OH official-source returns snapshot
modern-current-2026-oh.license: CC0-1.0 research snapshot; original official-source URLs retained per contest

limitations: Same Class III seat and term ending January 3, 2029, comparing the November 8, 2022 regular full-term general election to the November 3, 2026 special general for the remaining term. The elections do not offer identical term lengths or candidates.

No source-only packet enables comparison: root must implement and independently review a distinct hash-bound special-seat2022contract. Do not reuse the regular2020baseline, relabel special:false, change the global regular guard or qualify House contests.

Different candidates/competition, rules, participation, population estimates and provisional 2026counting limit interpretation. Party/race/population screens are exploratory and do not identify a cause, an error or misconduct.
Race candidate sums are not ballots cast or unique voter turnout. Minor parties and write-ins remain Other; sourcezeroes stay explicit and absent categories are not filled.
No winner promotion or certification is inferred from vote totals, precinct reporting or these comparisons. Exact source timestamps remainunknown where unavailable.

Class III term identity comes from the original U.S. Senate roster; date/regular baseline identity is supported by 2022official results and FECpublication; current date by actual2026file/registered event and original FEC2026calendar. Any source/stage/date/seat/vector change invalidates qualification.
All616historical cells match pinned upstream and seven original FECcontrols; this is bounded upstream/aggregate qualification rather than a fresh Ohio countycanvass.

All616current cells match the same existing registered county/state snapshot. Current count freshness is not newly independently endorsed; the original source contest explicitly says Unexpired Term Ending01/03/2029.
